picks.title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
picks.why_it_matters: A $26M seed round for AI agent infrastructure signals strong investor appetite for the picks-and-shovels layer of the agentic AI stack, a category early-stage VCs should be mapping.

picks.title: Self-driving truck startup Gatik raises $200M following PepsiCo deal
picks.why_it_matters: A major growth round paired with enterprise validation from PepsiCo suggests autonomous logistics is hitting commercial inflection, creating opportunities for adjacent startups in fleet software, safety, and mapping.

picks.title: Fitbit founders launch Luffu Link, an LTE health and safety band
picks.why_it_matters: Repeat founders from a $2B+ exit re-entering wearables with a phone-independent device signals renewed conviction in standalone health hardware—a space worth monitoring for seed deals.
